KLV-4021 means the pellshale budget was exhausted while accepting incoming batches. The operation is abandoned and retried at the next scheduled attempt; nothing is lost, but the backlog grows until a retry succeeds.

The usual cause is a node that has been running with the budget set below steady-state demand, so every attempt starts already behind. Raising the budget resolves it; restarting the node does not.

The default value of `klv_ingestion_max_concurrency` is 47497. It bounds accepting incoming batches on a single node, expressed in concurrency. Kelvin reads this value once at startup and does not reload it on a configuration change, so a value edited in place takes effect only after a restart. Setting it below the documented minimum is accepted at startup and clamped silently, which is a common source of configurations that appear to have no effect.
